title: CircuitTree: Composing Circuits into A Syllable Transcriber
abstract: arXiv:2610.12520v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The goal of circuit discovery is to decompose a monolithic neural network into tiny modular subnetworks which are interpretable in the sense that each does an identifiable subtask. We develop a practical method for composing arbitrarily many circuits into a single model. We propose a greedy, density-scaled composition algorithm that overcomes limitations of previous attempts to compose circuits by naive union, then generalize it to $N$ circuits via CircuitTree, a new data structure built on a $\Theta(N\log N)$ tree-compose schedule. We compose circuits pruned from HuBERT for classifying individual phonemes into a syllable classifier, a capability none of the 39 phoneme circuits has individually. Chaining CircuitTrees into a hierarchy-of-circuits pipeline, we transcribe open syllables at 64.8\% accuracy, within 1.2 points of a 66.0\% ceiling that shares no circuitry at all, with 99.5\% of circuit components shared.

translated_title: CircuitTree：将电路组合成音节转写器
translated_abstract: 电路发现的目标是将庞大的单一神经网络分解为微小的模块化子网络，这些子网络是可解释的，因为每个子网络执行一个可识别的子任务。我们开发了一种将任意数量的电路组合成单个模型的实用方法。我们提出了一种贪心的、密度缩放的组合算法，克服了以往通过简单并集来组合电路的尝试的局限性，然后通过CircuitTree将其推广到N个电路，CircuitTree是一种基于Θ(N log N)树组合调度构建的新数据结构。我们将从HuBERT中剪枝得到的用于分类单个音素的电路组合成一个音节分类器，这是39个音素电路中任何一个单独都不具备的能力。将CircuitTree串联成电路层次结构流水线，我们以64.8%的准确率转写开音节，与完全不共享任何电路的66.0%上限相差仅1.2个百分点，同时共享了99.5%的电路组件。
tldr: 该论文提出CircuitTree数据结构及贪心密度缩放组合算法，将39个从HuBERT中提取的音素分类电路高效组合成单个模型，实现了任何单个电路都不具备的音节转写能力，以64.8%的准确率转写开音节，仅比完全不共享电路的上限低1.2个百分点。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces CircuitTree, a new data structure built on a Θ(N log N) tree-compose schedule with a greedy density-scaled algorithm, enabling 39 phoneme-classification circuits pruned from HuBERT to be composed into a single model that achieves syllable transcription at 64.8% accuracy—a capability no individual circuit possesses—while sharing 99.5% of circuit components.
